_comment: VS Code / GitHub Copilot MCP server configuration for the DTDS Backstage portal.
_usage: Copy this file to .vscode/mcp.json in your workspace, or merge into an existing file.
_prerequisites: 1. Start the DTDS Backstage portal: docker run --rm -p 7007:7007 -e BACKSTAGE_MCP_TOKEN=dtds-mcp-demo-token-change-in-production dtds-backstage
3. In VS Code, open the MCP panel (Ctrl+Shift+P → 'MCP: List Servers') to activate the server.
